newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZCCM gives miners 15 pct wage increase.
newsitem.headline: ZCCM gives miners 15 pct wage increase.

text.p: Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines Ltd (ZCCM) has granted its workers a 15 percent wage increase, ending weeks of industrial tensions in the company, a ZCCM spokesman said on Friday.
"Despite the company's financial problems, unionised employees will receive a modest salary increase backdated to April 1, 1997," the spokesman said.
Employees were also given the right to purchase company houses they occupied and a provision under which their services with ZCCM and its predecessors after privatisation would be held in trust.
"This will ensure that and employee, on leaving service, would be compensated for his or her services redered to ZCCM and its predecessors where applicable," the spokesman said.
Mineworkers union chief Paul Kafumbe said the new conditions of service would avert an imminent strike by ZCCM workers.
The union last month rejected a 10 percent wage increase.
